snippet.title: Greenhouse: Schism | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Iffen ya want!!!! :
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3496980/Greenhouse_Schism/

Store Page Art & In Game Backgrounds by ricenoodlebrain!! :
https://www.instagram.com/ricenoodlebrain/

Music by Clam Shandy (Which is still me but just my music channel!):
@ClamShandy 

Thank yas for stopping by and checking out the game! Ere's some background info--- It's a remake of an old game I made called Schism though the game differs pretty dramatically in terms of content, lore and quality.  I've been working on it for like 7 months I think I'm not exactly sure. It's still probably a couple months out from completion from when this was uploaded.

Everything in the game (Excluding backgrounds & fonts) was made by me! So the music, coding (apart from some libraries) an art! 

Thanks for reading all this if ya did, Much appreciated!
